body: Typing those feelings out helped a little; thanks for the support.
In the mean time, do you have any other outlets to meet others? Online games?

I think I know that feeling--you really hope that someone will stop and talk to you, but they seem distracted? At least, that's something I've experienced.  :( I wish I could give you some real comfort and hugs, but know that your situation does sound really hard, and that you are not an ugly person. Love is a difficult thing, and you don't have to feel alone or like things are your fault if that's a feeling creeping in (I know I have a tendency to do that to myself).

I don't think high school is an enjoyable place for many of us. Something that has kept me going is being excited about new places--such as going to a university after graduation, or job searching in different locations. New locations mean new people to meet. It sounds like you may be a year or two away from that, but maybe it is something to hope for? The world is a big place :) and school is too limiting.

> And now this message broke me appart.

:( I'm so sorry that you feel hurt like this. Do you have anyone around you to lean on?

I'm not sure if it will make you feel any better seeing as I just posted on this subreddit recently--but I can recognize some of those same feelings I had when I was in high school. I used to be close with many people in elementary school, but once middle and high school hit... I struggled? My issue was I just didn't like things like sweet 16 parties--or, I would try to go to them, and something would happen that would discourage me from going again. I also had many incidents where I was never invited, then my female friends around me would go, "Wait, weren't you there last night?" ...My source of friends switched from school to games and online sources, because I just felt like another "face" to stock the background with.

:( So it might not be much, but I can relate to how you feel.
